sourceRefs.locator: Gregory IX.42; Epistolae 914, first paragraphs and final appeal: Chlothar’s resources, Agnes’s election, obedience of the founder, protection of property, and burial in the church dedicated to Mary even if unfinished.
Introduction and “Playing the crowd”, “Beyond the gates”, “Reaching east”: Fortunatus and Baudonivia, the donations (Vita I.12–13), the Rule and communal gifts, and the eastern mission (Vita II.16).
Notice pddn_hagio.202110061928562430200, Mort and Éléments d’identification: Radegund died at Poitiers in August 587.

summary.de: Als Frau aus dem thüringischen Königshaus heiratete sie Chlothar I. und gründete später eine Frauengemeinschaft in Poitiers. Ihr Brief nennt Agnes als Äbtissin.
summary.en: Born into the Thuringian royal family, she married Chlothar I and later founded a women’s community at Poitiers. Her letter names Agnes as abbess.
